_why: Skill-candidates row 'check for a live run before merging a shared skill change': a skill change lands in every session at once, and `3219bdd` invalidated a mid-cycle decision in another lane. `h_mad_live_runs.py` names live lanes; these rows prove each rule has a test that bites.

mutations.name: stale-claims-count-as-live
mutations._mechanism: A claim abandoned hours ago is reported as a running lane, so the warning cries wolf.

mutations.name: an-unreadable-state-reads-as-none
mutations._mechanism: A state file that could not be parsed is skipped, and 'could not check' prints NONE.

except ValueError as exc:

mutations.name: failed-discovery-reads-as-none
mutations._mechanism: No worktree list becomes an empty one, and nothing checked prints NONE.

mutations.name: every-commit-warns
mutations._mechanism: The warning fires on commits that touch no skill, so it is learned to be ignored.

mutations.name: a-staged-skill-change-is-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The one commit the warning exists for prints nothing.
